key.name: device-address
key.description: MAC address of the Bluetooth device to monitor for proximity (e.g. "AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF"). The device must be paired before it will be detected. Set with: gsettings set io.github.eustasy.BluetoothProximityLocker device-address 'XX:XX:XX:XX:XX:XX'

key.name: freeze-time
key.description: After unlocking the screen, the session will not be locked again for this many seconds — even if the device goes out of range. This prevents an immediate re-lock when you return to your desk and then step away briefly.

key.name: disconnect-delay
key.description: How many seconds the device must remain disconnected before the screen is locked. A small delay guards against brief Bluetooth dropouts triggering an unwanted lock.
